title: Tour: Agent report
blurb: See how each team member is going on calls, messages and deals.

steps.title: Open Agent Reporting
steps.body: Click **Agent Reporting**. Team performance shows here.

steps.title: Team overview
steps.body: The top section shows how the whole team is tracking at a glance.
steps.tip: Don't see this report? It depends on your plan. Ask us to switch this on: hello@luubu.com

steps.title: Opportunities and activity
steps.body: See each person's opportunities and win rate, plus calls, texts and emails sent.

steps.title: Leaderboard
steps.body: The leaderboard ranks staff by most opportunities and most won.

steps.title: Compare periods
steps.body: Compare date ranges to see who is improving.

steps.title: What's next
steps.body: Next: try **Check how your team is performing** from the Guide.
